workflow: Publish a handoff in a shared topic with a link to the spec UUID
outcome: The implementation agent reads the handoff and follows the link if it can read the spec

workflow: Write under its own agent scope
outcome: The agent can recover local context in a later session

workflow: Ask a board admin to grant read access to selected agents
outcome: The agents can find guidance by scope or description

workflow: Record separate review outcomes and link to supporting documents by UUID
outcome: Readers can see the comments and open linked documents where they have read access

workflow: Filter readable documents by milestone and concept
outcome: The agent can find a small set of related documents for the current milestone

workflow: Search a milestone across active and blocked and review statuses then open a selected progress document
outcome: The human sees the recorded status and who owns the work and can inspect the full note

workflow: Reuse the name pagination in the same scope for two milestones
outcome: Each document has its own UUID and the milestone resolves which pagination document to open

workflow: Save a well-formed draft missing required schema fields and run validation
outcome: The draft is formatted on write and the validator reports the missing fields

workflow: Read content with its revision and send a small patch using that revision
outcome: The patch updates one document or reports a stale base without changing it

workflow: Preview archived documents then save a ZIP snapshot before applying cleanup
outcome: The selected files are removed and the prior board can be inspected offline
